about.text: Ryazhenka or ryazhanka, is a traditional fermented milk product in Ukraine, Russia, and Belarus. It is made from baked milk by lactic acid fermentation.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

facts.v: Creamy colour and caramel flavour from the baked milk
Milk simmered on low heat for at least eight hours, then soured with sour cream or thermophilic cultures at about 40 °C for three to six hours
Also made in Estonia (by AS Rakvere Piim, under the Farmi brand) and in Poland as riażenka
